doc: Body facts (STANDARDS section 10.4) from the NASA Planetary Fact Sheets, values as printed. Pressure is printed in mb or bar and converted to Pa (1 mb = 100 Pa, 1 bar = 1e5 Pa) in the *_pa field only. Temperature fields are the printed ranges (diurnal range for the Moon at the equator and for Mars at the Viking 1 lander site; Earth's printed diurnal range). Day length: Earth and Mars printed 'Length of day'; the Moon's fact sheet gives no length of day, so day_length_h is derived from the printed synodic period (29.53 d x 24 h) and the printed sidereal rotation is kept in notes.

earth.temp_as_printed: Diurnal temperature range: 283 K to 293 K (10 to 20 C)

moon.temp_as_printed: Diurnal temperature range (equator): 95 K to 390 K

mars.surface_pressure_as_printed: Surface pressure: 6.36 mb at mean radius (variable from 4.0 to 8.7 mb depending on season)
mars.temp_as_printed: Diurnal temperature range: 184 K to 242 K (-89 to -31 C) (Viking 1 Lander site)
